Yes, the Archive behavior matches what I wanted — I can quietly set something aside from the little menu, it gets its own safe home that I can search when I mean to, it stays out of my everyday list and searches otherwise, and I can pull it back whenever I change my mind. That's settled for me.

The one companion piece it brings to mind: because Archive is deliberately the *reversible* "just tuck it away" option, I'd also want a way to genuinely get rid of a bookmark for good — something I know I'll never want again and don't want cluttering even the archive. In my head those are two different actions: "set aside, I might want it later" versus "delete, I'm done with this for real." So I'd expect a real delete to exist alongside archive, clearly separate so I don't confuse the two. Whenever you're ready to show me that, I'd like to see it — but the archiving itself is exactly right.
